Title: Manoj's Day

Cast

1. Manoj - 28 years, son
Look: blue shirt, black trousers
2. Anjali - 59 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans
3. Karan - 67 years, father
Look: glasses, brown sweater

Places

1. The office - desks, computers, a glass wall
2. The mall - a row of shops, an escalator
3. The hospital ward - white beds, a drip stand

Scene 1: The office - Day

[Manoj stands in the office. Karan stands near him.]

Manoj: "Today feels like a good day."

[Manoj presses the lift button and waits.]

Manoj: "Dad, listen!"

[Manoj checks his watch impatiently.]

Karan: "Yes, all right."

Scene 2: The mall - Day

[Manoj stands in the mall. Anjali and Karan stand near him.]

Karan: "So, here we are!"

[Manoj tries on a new jacket.]

Manoj (softly): "Wow, how lovely!"

[Manoj pays at the counter.]

Manoj (softly): "Yes, of course."

[Manoj carries the shopping bags out.]

Karan (excited): "What happened?"

Scene 3: The hospital ward - Day

[Manoj stands in the ward. Anjali and Karan stand near him.]

Manoj: "What a nice place."

[Mother passes away, and Manoj covers her body with a white sheet.]

Manoj (excited): "No… this cannot be!"
